source.title: Peruvian Amazon birds frogs daytime
source.author: nonamethefish
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo, 58 s, upland forest in the Peruvian Amazon in the afternoon: rain frogs ticking at 2.5-5.5 kHz, a tinamou, birds and insects, steady throughout and already clean below 300 Hz (the high-pass only tidies it).
